tldr: Mars in the 5th house routes drive and action through joy and self-expression.
body: With Mars in the 5th house, drive, assertion, desire, conflict, courage, heat, and the ability to act move through creativity, joy, romance, pleasure, play, and children. This makes how you create, flirt, play, risk, and let pleasure be part of life a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become initiative, courage, stamina, directness, and the power to move this area forward. Left unconscious, it can become impatience, defensiveness, conflict for its own sake, or burning through this area faster than it can stabilize.
gift: initiative, courage, stamina, directness, and the power to move this area forward expressed through joy and self-expression.
challenge: impatience, defensiveness, conflict for its own sake, or burning through this area faster than it can stabilize concentrated in joy and self-expression.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
